description: This file defines the NatsConnectionManager class, which acts as a wrapper around NATS and JetStream APIs for managing connections, stream creation, message enqueueing, consumer creation, and acknowledgments within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: NatsConnectionManager
classes.description: A sealed class providing connection management, stream setup, message publishing, consumer creation, and acknowledgment functionalities for NATS and JetStream within Orleans.

methods.name: NatsConnectionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection manager with provider name, logger factory, and options, setting up connections and contexts.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes connection to NATS server, verifies JetStream availability, creates stream if not existing, and logs the process.

methods.name: EnqueueMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a message into the NATS JetStream stream on a specific subject derived from message stream ID.

methods.name: CreateConsumer
methods.description: Creates a new NatsStreamConsumer for a specified partition.

methods.name: AcknowledgeMessages
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment for messages on a specified subject.
